item.title: Nvidia shares jump 6% after earnings beat, data center revenue hits record
item.description: NVDA rose in extended trading after the chipmaker posted revenue of $60 billion and raised guidance. Rival AMD also gained.

item.title: Dow falls 400 points as Treasury yields climb ahead of Fed decision
item.description: Wall Street stocks fell on Wednesday with the S&P 500 and Nasdaq lower as the 10-year yield rose above 4.5%.

item.title: Apple (AAPL) unveils new iPhone lineup; shares little changed
item.description: Apple stock was flat after the event. Alphabet and Microsoft shares also traded near record highs.

item.title: Fed holds rates steady, signals one cut later this year
item.description: The Federal Reserve kept its benchmark interest rate unchanged; Powell said inflation remains above target.

item.title: Visa applications surge for Hajj season, travel agents say
item.description: Travel demand and airline bookings are up ahead of the pilgrimage season.

item.title: Wall Street week ahead: bank earnings and CPI inflation data in focus
item.description: JPMorgan and Goldman Sachs report quarterly results; investors watch the consumer price index.
